title: Velopin
description: Places a waypoint at your current position. If a waypoint already exists, it is automatically replaced with a new one at your current location.
body:
# Waypoint Marker

Waypoint Marker is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you quickly mark any location and navigate back to it using a simple on-screen indicator.

Set a waypoint with a single key press and follow the direction arrow back whenever you need it.

---

## Features

* Instantly create a waypoint
* Direction arrow HUD
* Real-time distance display
* Automatic waypoint replacement
* Automatic waypoint saving
* Minimalist interface
* Lightweight and performance-friendly

---

## How It Works

Press **K** to create a waypoint at your current position.

After placing a waypoint, a compact HUD displays:

* Direction arrow
* Distance in blocks

Simply follow the arrow until you reach your destination.

Press **K** again to replace the existing waypoint with a new one.

Press **L** to remove the current waypoint.

---

## Smart HUD

The waypoint indicator automatically hides when you are within **10 blocks** of the destination, keeping your screen clean and uncluttered.

---

## Automatic Saving

Waypoints are saved automatically and remain available after restarting the game.

No manual saving is required.

---

## Default Hotkeys

**K** — Create or replace a waypoint

**L** — Remove the current waypoint

Keybindings can be changed in Minecraft's Controls menu.

---

## Performance

Waypoint Marker is designed to be lightweight and has virtually no impact on game performance.

---

## Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer

---

## Requirements

* Fabric API
